name: performance-contracts
permissions: run declared benchmark commands with argument arrays and no shell
copy the repository without .git into a temporary directory for negative-control runs
risks: agent loosens a budget to turn a failing check green
agent weakens a negative control or points its anchor at unrelated text so a blind gate looks validated
a synthetic counter control is mistaken for proof of sensitivity to a real regression
a counter that never varies gives a budget that cannot detect regressions
wall-clock timing from a noisy or incompatible runner produces false alarms
finite workload sizes are mistaken for proof of asymptotic complexity
a dropped-output optimization passes because only timing was checked
mitigations: budget changes require a separate maintain-mode diff with a stated reason
every gated assertion needs a negative control whose anchor occurs exactly once, and each control must violate its own metric
synthetic controls are labelled in discrimination evidence as wiring checks only
a counter that no run moves is reported as insensitive
timing is advisory and only deterministic counters gate in v1
verdicts state that finite sizes are a bounded sample
correctness is asserted against an independent oracle before any timing
ethical_considerations: do not present unmeasured speedups as measured results
